title: Stepwise Construction of Extra-Large Heterometallic Calixarene-Based Cages

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Dy–Ni–Na thiacalixarene nanocage with BDC linkers

synthesis.procedure: Compound 1a and 1,4-benzenedicarboxylic acid were combined in DMF with five drops of water, sealed in a 23 mL glass vial, heated at 85 °C for one day, and cooled to room temperature. The resulting green hexagonal crystals were washed with fresh DMF. The precursor mass and yield are not transcribed because their numerals are corrupted in the supplied Markdown.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Sealed 23 mL glass vial; stepwise reaction of a preformed cluster with a dicarboxylic acid
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cooled to room temperature; green hexagonal crystals washed with fresh DMF.

properties.summary: The Dy cage exhibits frequency-dependent out-of-phase ac susceptibility under zero dc field, consistent with slow magnetic relaxation, although no χ″ maximum was observed down to 2 K and no obvious hysteresis loop was observed.

source_locations.location: Supplied CCDC catalog row; matched by Dy/BDC composition and first structure in Table 1

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Two preformed Na2Ni12Dy2 cluster units are joined by three BDC linkers to form a discrete trigonal-prismatic Na4Ni24Dy4 cage.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Dy–Ni–Na thiacalixarene nanocage with NDC linkers

synthesis.procedure: Compound 1a and 2,6-naphthalenedicarboxylic acid were mixed in equal volumes of DMF and NMP with five drops of water, sealed in a 23 mL glass vial, heated at 85 °C for three days, and cooled to room temperature. Green hexagonal crystals were washed with fresh 1:1 DMF/NMP. The precursor mass and yield are not transcribed because their numerals are corrupted in the supplied Markdown.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Sealed 23 mL glass vial; stepwise reaction
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cooled to room temperature; green hexagonal crystals washed with fresh 1:1 DMF/NMP.

source_locations.location: Supplied CCDC catalog row; matched by NDC-dependent composition and Table 1 sequence

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Three NDC linkers join two Na2Ni12Dy2 building blocks into a discrete trigonal-prismatic cage larger than the BDC-linked HMONC-1.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Dy–Ni–Na thiacalixarene nanocage with BPDC linkers

synthesis.procedure: The HMONC-2 procedure was followed with 4,4′-biphenyldicarboxylic acid in place of 2,6-naphthalenedicarboxylic acid: precursor 1a and linker in 2.5 mL each of DMF and NMP with five drops of water were sealed in a 23 mL glass vial and heated at 85 °C for three days before cooling and washing with 1:1 DMF/NMP. The reported yield numeral is corrupted in the supplied Markdown.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Sealed 23 mL glass vial; HMONC-2 procedure with substituted linker
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cooled to room temperature and washed with fresh 1:1 DMF/NMP, following the HMONC-2 procedure.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Tb–Ni–Na thiacalixarene nanocage with BDC linkers

synthesis.procedure: The HMONC-1 procedure was followed with the Tb-containing precursor 1b in place of Dy-containing 1a: precursor and 1,4-benzenedicarboxylic acid in 5 mL DMF with five drops of water were sealed in a 23 mL glass vial, heated at 85 °C for one day, cooled, and the resulting crystals washed with fresh DMF. The precursor mass and reported yield are not transcribed because their numerals are corrupted in the supplied Markdown.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Sealed 23 mL glass vial; HMONC-1 procedure with Tb precursor 1b
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cooled to room temperature; crystals washed with fresh DMF, following the HMONC-1 procedure.

properties.summary: Magnetic behavior of the Tb analogue was studied and reported as similar to that of the previously reported Na2Ni12Ln2 cluster; the main article directs the reader to supporting-information figures for its data.

source_locations.location: Supplied CCDC catalog row; matched by Tb composition and Table 1 sequence
